content: Service Name Can SM_ Controller Bus Off Syntax void Can SM_ Controller Bus Off ( uint8 Controller Id ) Service ID [hex] 0x04 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant (only for different Can Controllers) Parameters (in) Controller Id CAN controller, which detected a bus - off event Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This callback function notifies the Can SM about a bus - off event on a certain CAN controller, which needs to be considered with the specified bus - off recovery handling for th e impacted CAN network. Available via Can SM_ Can If.h
